mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feedings (user_id, pet_id, fed_at, food_type, amount_g, note) VALUES (#{userId}, #{petId}, #{fedAt}, #{foodType}, #{amountG}, #{note})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM feedings WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND pet_id = #{petId} ORDER BY fed_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feeding_plans (user_id, pet_id, order_id, plan_content, adjust_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{petId}, #{orderId}, #{planContent}, #{adjustCount})
mapper.update: UPDATE feeding_plans SET plan_content = #{planContent}, adjust_count = #{adjustCount} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM feeding_plans WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND pet_id = #{petId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
